name: Prone Y-Raise
steps: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended straight and forehead resting gently on the floor or a small towel.
Extend your arms overhead at roughly a 30-degree angle from your body so they form the letter 'Y', with your thumbs pointing straight toward the ceiling.
Engage your mid-back and lower trapezius to lift your arms and chest a few inches off the floor without straining your neck.
Hold the top position for one to two seconds while focusing on squeezing your lower shoulder blades down and together.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position with controlled breathing.
coaching_cues: Keep your thumbs pointed toward the ceiling throughout the movement to encourage external rotation.
Avoid hyperextending your lower back; focus movement exclusively in your shoulder blades.
Keep your neck neutral and gaze pointed straight at the floor.
